description: Two independent slew limiters, each a one-pole lag whose corner is set by a knob

params.text: Sets how far the output lags the input: fully counter-clockwise puts the filter corner at 10Hz, and turning clockwise drops the corner towards a standstill

outputs.text: The slewed version of that channel's input

notes: the lag is a resistor-and-capacitor curve rather than a constant slope, so a pitch voltage sent through it will not move evenly per octave on its way between notes.
the knobs are read at 100Hz rather than at the audio sample rate, so turning one changes the corner in steps.
